אשמח למענה בעברית או באנגלית 🙂

hello, my partner (german) is currently staying in israel on a work & holiday visa that was issued for her in germany - important note, when she was asked if she have a family in israel, she stated that she has a boyfriend.
the w&h visa was granted through the embassy in Germany. shortly after she arrived in Israel. we went to PIBA to pick up the visa, where they told us the wasn’t eligible for the w&h as her file said she had a partner here. they ended up granting the visa anyway, but only for 6 months instead of a year and instructed us to begin the partner visa process immediately which we did.
we want to ask a few questions:
1. Once we gather the documents and apply online, while she still in Israel – can she legally stay here? Do we need to apply for a new status?
2. Can we request an extension of the current W&H visa for additional 6 months?
3. should we request an urgent meeting in PIBA and show up before her visa expires?
4. we think that since PIBA directly instructed us to apply for the shared life procedure and because I am now already in her file there with name and ID no, that it’s best to continue this track and apply from here (our documents are all ready by end of week). Is it might after all still be better to apply from abroad and whether this path we are somewhat accidentally on, applying from israel from a different visa, might make it harder rather than easier.
